parsed.rationale: The eight members in this cluster span four unrelated packages (Playback, DebugPanel, Wallpaper, Intents) and cover entirely distinct domain concepts: audio streaming state (StreamingAudioState, PlayerState, PlaybackState, PlaybackError), thermal-state display helpers (ProcessInfo.ThermalState extensions in DebugPanel and Wallpaper), an intent error type (IntentError in Intents), and a test-local timeout error (TimeoutError in MP3StreamDecoderTests). The structural signal is that all share 'shared_field_count: 1' — almost certainly an empty body or a single trivial member — which is coincidental rather than meaningful duplication. Consolidating these types would conflate unrelated concerns across package boundaries and would not reduce real duplication.
